subject: HelioWorks — 2-year prepay option and final approved concession
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna White <anna.white@helioworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: HelioWorks: multi-year purchase options & ramped billing

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to put two structured prepay options on paper so your procurement and finance teams can review side-by-side. High level first, details below.

Option A — 3-year prepay (preferred economics)
- Total commitment: $3.6M over 36 months (prepay upfront)
- Effective blended discount vs list: 32%
- Yearly ramp: 25% / 35% / 40%
- Billing: single upfront invoice

Option B — 2-year prepay (requested alternate)
- Total commitment: $2.4M over 24 months (prepay upfront)
- Effective blended discount vs list: 28% (base); can include one-tier escalator tied to usage ramp
- Yearly ramp: 30% / 70% (year 2 higher utilization assumed)
- Billing: option to split into 2 invoices (yearly) or single upfront

Notes / asks:
- We can include a 12-month price protection clause for the baseline model family.
- If you prefer quarterly or split billing, we can accommodate with a nominal admin fee.
- Please confirm whether HelioWorks needs specific invoice language, PO number format, or payment wiring instructions.

I attached a simple rate table with the unit math so you can plug into your internal model. Happy to schedule a quick call to walk procurement through the numbers.

Attachment: HelioWorks_Rate_Table_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

Best,
Alex Martinez

Alex —

Thanks for the clear options. Procurement will want to see a 2-year committed option as a primary path; their preference is a shorter term with a deeper immediate discount so our CFO can justify the cash outlay. A few follow-ups:

1) Can you move the 2-year discount to 32%?
2) Can you confirm whether billing can be split into two equal annual invoices but still be considered a prepaid commitment for service SLAs?
3) We need standard SOW language and a sample invoice for our AP team.

If you can provide the revised numbers and a short SOW we can circle back with internal approval next week.

Thanks,

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-14T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: HelioWorks 2yr ask — need finance approval (pricing request)

Team — forwarding HelioWorks' ask (Anna copied above). They are pushing for 32% on a 2-year prepay and want the option to split billing annually while retaining prepay commitment terms.

Why this matters: this is a strategic win in the datacomp/edge market and they have competitive timelines. The HubSpot opp is HW-98765 (attaching my calc). If we can offer up to 28% today we should be able to close inside two weeks; 32% would be a deep concession.

Attached: pricing_calc_helioworks.csv (calc, 6KB)

Questions:
- Neha: do we have flexibility to bridge to 32% with conditional terms (e.g., upfront payment plus usage-based escalator)?
- Vivek: from a quota/strategy standpoint, would you sign-off on 28% as a firm discount?

If helpful I can jump on a quick sync.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelioWorks 2yr ask — need finance approval (pricing request)

Alex —

Reviewed the calc. A few thoughts and an approval boundary:

- We should not go to 32% flat on a 2-year prepay without conditional protections. The 32% request would materially impact our unit economics.
- Approve offering a 28% flat discount for a 2-year prepay under either of the following two conditions (pick one):
  a) Single upfront payment for full 24-month commitment (preferred from cash and risk perspective).
  b) Split into two annual invoices *but* include a non-refundable first-year payment equal to 60% of the commitment and a clause that accelerates the remainder if HelioWorks reduces committed usage >20% in year 2.

Additionally:
- We can add an escalator clause: if monthly usage exceeds the committed baseline by more than 15% for two consecutive months, unit price for the excess resets to public list (protects against unexpected overconsumption).
- For governance: Finance signs off on up to 28% as long as Legal reviews the acceleration and non-refundable language.

I attached a draft clause set we typically use for split-billing prepay deals. If they insist on 32% we can consider 30% for an immediate exec credit equivalent to 2 months of service (i.e., concession delivered as credit rather than price).

Attachment: HelioWorks_MultiYear_Terms_2yr_v3.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelioWorks 2yr ask — need finance approval (pricing request)

Go with Neha's approach. Approve 28% with the split-billing guardrails if needed. Add one ask: include a 6-month performance review clause and the option for a one-time 90-day pause if there is a force majeure or a documented platform migration window.

From a sales standpoint, HelioWorks is strategic; if this helps accelerate Q4 revenue and sets a long-term reference, I back the 28% w/ conditions. Once Legal confirms the contract language, proceed to finalize offer and send for signature.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-16T08:34:00-08:00
Subject: Final 2-year prepay offer — HelioWorks (approved)

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Below is the approved 2-year prepaid offer we can present to HelioWorks procurement:

Offer (final):
- Term: 24 months, prepaid commitment
- Commitment amount: $2.4M total
- Discount: 28% off list (firm)
- Billing: option A — single upfront invoice; option B — split into two equal annual invoices with the following guardrail: first-year payment non-refundable at 60% of total commitment, and acceleration if committed usage drops >20% in year 2.
- Ramp assumption: year 1 baseline 30% of committed usage, year 2 catch-up to 70% (we documented baseline in the attached SOW sample).
- Price protection: 12 months for the baseline model family; escalator on excess usage as noted by Neha.
- Addendum: 6-month performance review and one-time 90-day pause option for scheduled migrations (as approved by Vivek).

Next steps:
1) Legal will push a clean SOW and the split-billing addendum to you today.
2) If you accept, we'll send the DocuSign. Payment terms and wire instructions will be on the invoice.

Attachments: HelioWorks_MultiYear_Terms_2yr_v3.pdf; pricing_calc_helioworks.csv
Related link: https://docusign.com/helioworks-2yr-sign

Please let me know and I can route to Legal ASAP.

Best,
